summary.intent: Resolve open PR review comments on a load testing branch, then refactor the api-client package from a module-level singleton to instance-scoped axios so each CipherBoxClient owns its own HTTP instance — eliminating cross-instance contamination in tests and enabling true parallel load testing.
summary.outcome: All PR review threads resolved and pushed. The singleton was fully eliminated: CipherBoxClient now creates (or accepts) its own axios instance, SdkContext threads it through all IPNS/folder/file/bin operations, the web app creates one shared instance passed to both the singleton registration and CipherBoxClient, and test infrastructure workarounds (switchTo, setApiClientConfig calls) were removed.

repo: Two layers of rate limiting exist in the API: controller-level @UseGuards(ThrottlerGuard) (bypass works) and per-endpoint @Throttle() decorators with strict limits (e.g., 10 IPNS publishes/min) — the bypass header may not reach the per-endpoint decorators.

Phase 19.1 roadmap shows '6/6 plans complete' with unchecked checkboxes — web app was only partially rewired to CipherBoxClient; 13 files still imported directly from @cipherbox/api-client for auth, shares, invites, device approval, health checks, IPFS, and IPNS.

The web app uses both CipherBoxClient (folder/file/bin CRUD) and direct generated function calls (auth, vault init, shares API) — the refactor unified these onto one axios instance created in api-config.ts.
sdk-core does not list axios as a direct dependency; AxiosInstance type must be imported via @cipherbox/api-client re-export, not directly from 'axios'.
429 errors during pnpm test run are caused by parallel test suites all hitting the live API simultaneously — not a code issue; SDK integration tests pass in isolation.

code.finding: customInstance now accepts an optional _axiosInstance in options to bypass the singleton; createAxiosInstance includes 401 refresh logic; setApiClientConfig accepts a pre-built instance.
SdkContext gains optional axiosInstance field used to thread the per-client axios instance through all SDK operations.
createAndPublishIpnsRecord, batchPublishIpnsRecords, and resolveIpnsRecord all accept optional ctx parameter to forward the axios instance.
CipherBoxClient constructor accepts optional axiosInstance in config; if provided uses it, otherwise calls createAxiosInstance(). Instance is stored in SdkContext.
CipherBoxClientConfig gains optional axiosInstance and defaultHeaders fields. AxiosInstance imported via @cipherbox/api-client, not directly from axios.
Now creates ONE axios instance with auth token injection and 401 refresh, registers it as the singleton via setApiClientConfig, and exports it for use by CipherBoxClient.
initSdkClient now imports the shared axiosInstance from api-config and passes it into CipherBoxClient config, ensuring both call paths use the same instance.
Mock assertions needed updating after ctx parameter was added — toHaveBeenCalledWith now includes undefined as second argument for backward-compatible calls.
loadBinMetadataInternal and saveBinMetadata were calling resolveIpnsRecord and createAndPublishIpnsRecord without forwarding ctx — missed in initial pass, fixed in follow-up.
switchTo() method removed entirely — no longer needed since each CipherBoxClient instance maintains its own auth state via its own axios instance.
curl -s silently succeeds on HTTP 5xx; changed to curl -fsS so health check readiness loop correctly fails on server errors.

workflow: When grepping for IPNS callers after a signature change, also check packages/sdk/src/bin/ — it's a separate entry point that's easy to miss.
Running pnpm test across all packages in parallel causes live API rate limiting (429s) on integration tests; run packages in isolation or with brief pauses to get clean results.
The GSD check-todos workflow uses a gsd-tools.cjs init command to load todo context including count, list, and pending_dir before displaying the interactive list.

friction: Missed bin/index.ts IPNS callers in the initial pass — required a follow-up grep and additional edits after the main refactor was complete.
sdk-core/types.ts dynamic import of AxiosInstance failed at typecheck because axios isn't a direct dependency of sdk-core; had to use the @cipherbox/api-client re-export instead.
429 rate limit errors during parallel test runs made it hard to verify the test suite was clean — required running packages in isolation with cooldowns to confirm.
ipns.test.ts mock assertions broke after adding the optional ctx parameter — the toHaveBeenCalledWith matchers needed updating to include undefined.
open_items: Throttle bypass gap for per-endpoint @Throttle() decorators (api area) — todo moved to done but investigation is just starting; 429s in load tests may originate from per-endpoint strict limits not respecting the bypass header.

13 web app files still import directly from @cipherbox/api-client for non-CRUD operations (auth, shares, invites, device approval, health, IPFS, IPNS) — while they now share the same axios instance, they don't go through CipherBoxClient; full SDK migration deferred.
ROADMAP.md Phase 19.1 shows 6/6 plans with unchecked checkboxes — roadmap state is inconsistent with actual completion; needs reconciliation.
SDK integration tests hit the live API and are susceptible to rate limiting when run in parallel with other suites — no isolation or mocking strategy in place for the integration layer.
